aaExtensionDialingEnabled.description: When `true` auto attendant extension dialing is enabled.

aaNamingDialingEnabled.description: When `true` auto attendant dialing by first or last name is enabled.

enablePhoneStatusDirectoryPrivacy.description: When `true` phone status directory privacy is enabled.

enablePhoneStatusPickupBargeInPrivacy.description: When `true` privacy is enforced for call pickup and barge-in. Only members specified by `monitoringAgents` can pickup or barge-in on the call.

monitoringAgents.description: List of people that are being monitored.
